newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics in Web America supply pact.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics in Web America supply pact.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp on Tuesday said it would supply its Total Control remote access servers and its new x2 modem technology to Web America Networks, a Dallas-based Internet service provider.
Web America's system covers nearly 10,000 geographic areas nationwide, offering Internet access to an unspecified number of business and individual subscribers.
Web America officials said the company was one of the first to beta test U.S. Robotics' x2 technology, and it would receive thousands of modems from the manufacturing company.
U.S. Robotics shares closed two higher at 57-3/8.
